name: Oshikake Dorei!? ~Harikiri Kanojo to Yurui Hibi
original_name: おしかけ奴隷！？～はりきり彼女とゆるい日々～
source:
"Pleased to meet you. I am your slave."

Soushi Kanao had no girls in his life, and now suddenly he literally owned one.

This mysterious gift from god was named Koumi. She was a vision, but
it was bizarre how she matter-of-factly explained herself to be your slave.
It didn't make sense. Weird girl.

But so long as this thing was what it was, why not have fun?

A splendid, erotic, sweet, strange life with Koumi the slave begins.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ107123.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“很高兴认识你。我是你的奴隶。”

金尾宗史一生中没有过女孩，而现在他突然拥有了一个。

这个来自上帝的神秘礼物被命名为Koumi。她是一个幻象，但是
她实事求是地解释自己是你的奴隶，这很奇怪。
这没有道理。奇怪的女孩。

但只要事情是这样，为什么不玩得开心呢？

与奴隶小美的华丽、色情、甜蜜、奇异的生活开始了。
